about.title: An engineer who owns the whole product, not just a ticket.
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack software engineer who takes products from idea to production. At Exadev, I design and build scalable web and mobile applications with Laravel, React and React Native — owning everything from the database schema and REST APIs to the interface people actually use.

I hold an Engineering Degree (bac+6, Master's level) in Software Engineering and Business Intelligence from the International Institute of Technology of Sfax (2026), and a Bachelor's in Computer Science & Multimedia from ISIMS (2023). For my capstone, I designed and built an intelligent task-management platform on my own, end to end.
For three years I was an active member of the Microsoft Tech Club ISIMS — a reflection of how much I care about learning, sharing and moving technology forward with others.

omnichannel.title: Omnichannel Intelligent Task-Management Platform
omnichannel.org: Engineering capstone · International Institute of Technology
omnichannel.summary: A task-management platform that follows you across web, mobile and the browser — with an AI planning assistant, delay prediction and automated priority scheduling.
highlights: Web app, mobile app & browser extension
omnichannel.challenge: Tasks are scattered across devices and tools, and deciding what to work on next is still mostly guesswork. The goal was one platform that follows users across web, mobile and the browser and actively helps them plan their work — designed, built and delivered by a single engineer, on a production-grade architecture.
omnichannel.solution: I designed and built an omnichannel platform on a FastAPI microservices architecture, serving a React web app, a React Native mobile app and a browser extension. On top of a carefully designed database schema and REST APIs, I added three intelligent capabilities: a context-aware planning assistant powered by the Gemini API, a regression model that predicts task delays, and a CP-SAT optimization algorithm that schedules priorities automatically.

features.title: Three clients, one platform
features.text: A React web app, a React Native mobile app and a browser extension share the same APIs and data.

features.title: Context-aware planning assistant
features.text: A Gemini API integration that understands the user's context to help plan the work ahead.

features.title: Task-delay prediction
features.text: A regression model estimates which tasks are likely to slip, so users can act early.

features.title: Automated priority scheduling
features.text: A CP-SAT optimization algorithm turns priorities and constraints into a schedule.

features.title: Microservices back end
features.text: FastAPI services, a database schema and REST APIs designed for scalability, security and maintainability.

features.title: Full Agile lifecycle
features.text: Scoping, design, development, testing and deployment, run in Scrum as the sole developer.

omnichannel.outcome: A complete, intelligent product delivered end to end by one engineer: three client applications, a scalable microservices back end and three AI and optimization capabilities working together — the capstone of my engineering degree.

inventory.title: Inventory Management System
inventory.summary: A web-based inventory management system covering the product catalog, order processing and sales statistics.
inventory.challenge: Products, orders and sales data needed to live in one place, so the catalog could be managed, orders processed and performance understood without juggling separate tools.
inventory.solution: I developed a web application that brings the core of the business together: a structured product catalog, an order-processing workflow and a sales statistics dashboard.

features.title: Order processing

features.title: Sales statistics

inventory.outcome: One web platform for the full inventory cycle — from adding a product to understanding how it sells.

mobile.title: Cross-Platform Mobile Apps
mobile.summary: React Native apps for Android and iOS, shipped from design through production.
mobile.challenge: Reach users on both Android and iOS without maintaining two separate codebases — while keeping the experience smooth and native-feeling.
mobile.solution: I build cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and take them all the way from design to production, backed by the same secured REST APIs as the web products.

features.title: One codebase, two platforms
features.text: A single React Native codebase delivers apps for both Android and iOS.

features.title: From design to production

webapps.title: Full-Stack Web Applications & APIs
webapps.summary: Laravel + React platforms with secured REST APIs and optimized MySQL.
webapps.challenge: Product teams needed web applications that stay reliable and fast as they grow, with clean, dependable communication between front end and back end.
webapps.solution: I design and maintain full-stack applications with Laravel, React.js, PHP and JavaScript: secured REST API endpoints, optimized MySQL schemas and queries, and responsive interfaces built with React and Bootstrap — delivered in Agile Scrum with Git-based code reviews.

features.text: React.js and Bootstrap interfaces that work beautifully on every screen size.

features.title: Team workflow
features.text: Scrum ceremonies with cross-functional teams, Git/GitHub version control and code reviews.

webapps.outcome: More reliable, scalable applications for end users, with faster response times thanks to optimized schemas and queries.
